personality: 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT with 6 Glass / Luxe DARK surfaces
personality_one_liner: A highly authoritative, premium, and trustworthy legal assistant that balances editorial clarity in light mode with cinematic, expensive depth in dark mode.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for high legibility of legal documents. Card elements sit with 'lg' margins. Forms use single-column layouts with strong visual hierarchy.

do's: Use subtle glass over deep blue backgrounds for premium dashboard cards.
Bottom tab bar and sticky headers in list/document views.
Modal scrims and premium subscription plan highlights.
dont's: Avoid on form inputs or dense legal document texts.
Do not over-blur; keep text readability WCAG AA compliant.

screens.name: Splash
screens.purpose: Establish immediate authority with the 'The New Era of Advocacy' tagline and brand logo.

states.loading: Full bleed premium dark blue texture with gold logo fading in.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background using the dark navy premium texture image, centered logo and serif tagline at the bottom. A subtle top-down gradient scrim ensures text contrast.

screens.name: Dashboard (Home)
screens.purpose: Provide a high-level summary of advocate matters and direct entry points to key flows.

states.empty: No cases yet - clean illustration of a legal desk.
states.error: Unable to load dashboard. Retry button.

screens.layout: Top area: compact header with advocate name and global search. Primary summary: Welcome card with an inspiring legal quote. Secondary action grid: 2-column layout for 'Add Case', 'My Cases', and 'Continue Drafting'. Below this: Horizontal scroll for Categories (Civil/Criminal) and a 2-column grid of Most Used Templates. Tab bar fixed at bottom.

screens.name: Case Creation Flow
screens.purpose: Capture case details sequentially using dependent dropdowns for complaint type/laws.

states.error: Validation errors on inputs or failed to save.

screens.layout: Wizard pattern. Step 1: Language toggle (Gujarati/English), Case Nickname, Case Number. Step 2: Case Type dropdown. Step 3: Complaint Type (dependent on Step 2), Applicable Law, Section. Floating sticky CTA 'Next/Save' at the bottom. Progress train at the top.

screens.name: Application Generation Wizard
screens.purpose: Draft, review, and finalize legal applications securely.
screens.layout: Step 1: Auto-fill review (data from case). Step 2: Missing fields input (with Date picker). Step 3: WYSIWYG/Markdown preview of the document. Step 4: Output selection (PDF/Word), rename, save, and share. Uses a sticky bottom CTA to progress through steps.

screens.name: Subscription & Wallet
screens.purpose: Drive monetization through tier selection and credit usage visibility.
screens.layout: Hero section showing Credit Wallet (e.g., 'Remaining templates: 5'). Below: 3 tier cards styled with glassmorphism over a dark background for premium feel (₹299, ₹499, ₹999). Each card details benefits. 'Pay ₹9 for single template' as a subtle secondary link. Sticky 'Upgrade Now' button.

premium_backdrop.alt: abstract gold legal balance scales on dark background

instructions_to_main_agent: Adopt the user's explicit request for Deep Court Blue and Royal Gold palettes. Ensure the exact hexes from the 'color' block are used.
Utilize 'Libre Baskerville' for display headers to establish legal gravitas and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for high legibility in body/data texts.
For complex flows like 'Case Creation' and 'Application Generation', implement a clear Step-by-Step Wizard UI with dependent dropdowns updating reactively.
Implement multilingual support (Gujarati/English) via a clean toggle switch in the forms and global search.
In the Premium Subscription screen, use the 'premium_backdrop' image with a heavy gradient scrim behind glassmorphic pricing tier cards.
Enforce sticky primary CTA buttons at the bottom (respecting Safe Area) across all scrolling forms to ensure high conversion and ease-of-use.
